headlines.summary: 1만709건 거래…전년동기比 11% 급등 6억 초과하면 디딤돌대출 등 못 받아 매수세에 가격↑…“저가 아파트 소멸” 올해 서울에서 거래된 아파트 5채 중 1채 이상이 ‘6억원 이하’인 것으로 나타났다. 전셋값 급등에 대출 문턱마저 높아지자, 정책대출을 받을 수 있는 시세 6억원 이하의 집으로 매수세가 몰린 것으로 풀이된다.

key_headlines.title: ADB Raises South Korea's 2026 Growth Forecast to 3.2%
key_headlines.summary: The Asian Development Bank upgraded Korea's economic growth forecast by 0.6 percentage points to 3.2%, citing strong performance in AI semiconductors and exports. The organization also revised next year's growth forecast upward from 2.0% to 2.3%.

key_headlines.title: Korean Nuclear Technology Advances with US Partnership Plans
key_headlines.summary: South Korea and the US are jointly pursuing construction of 8 nuclear reactors including 6 Westinghouse AP1000 units and 2 Korean-made APR1400 units, expanding Korea's nuclear technology market presence globally.

key_headlines.title: Seoul Apartment Market Concentrated Below 600 Million Won Due to Policy Loan Cutoffs
key_headlines.summary: Over 22% of Seoul apartment transactions are now below 600 million won as buyers flock to properties eligible for government policy loans, with transactions up 11% year-over-year at 10,709 units.

key_headlines.title: Won-Dollar Exchange Rate Stabilizes Around 1,350 Won Amid Oil Price Fluctuations
key_headlines.summary: The won-dollar exchange rate has fallen again to around 1,350 won as oil prices decline on expectations of US-Iran tensions easing and Saudi Arabia expanding oil exports, with semiconductor export strength helping control currency appreciation.

key_headlines.title: Customs Service Eliminates Whistleblower Reward Caps to Combat Smuggling
key_headlines.summary: South Korea's Customs Service abolished the upper limit on informant rewards and introduced a progressive payment system with up to 3x multiplier bonuses to encourage voluntary reporting of illegal activities including smuggling and customs tax evasion.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's economic outlook has brightened significantly with the Asian Development Bank raising the 2026 growth forecast to 3.2%, boosted by strong AI semiconductor and export performance. The semiconductor sector continues to drive economic momentum, with technology exports expanding rapidly. Meanwhile, the real estate market shows signs of stress with apartment buyers concentrating below the 600 million won threshold due to government policy loan requirements. The won-dollar exchange rate has stabilized around 1,350 won as oil prices decline on geopolitical factors.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The US Federal Reserve raised interest rates while signaling potential for additional increases due to persistent inflation concerns, despite strong economic growth indicators. US business activity reached a 5-year high with PMI at 58.4, while real GDP growth is estimated at 5.1% on an annualized basis. The yield curve inversion between long and short-term US Treasury bonds has reached its narrowest level since March 2025, suggesting economic slowdown risks. The OECD raised global growth forecasts to 2.9%, citing AI-related investment benefits in data centers and semiconductor manufacturing countries including South Korea and Japan.
sections.Financial Markets: New York stock markets experienced volatility amid rising oil prices and Treasury yields, with the Nasdaq declining over 1% as the 10-year Treasury yield reached a 19-year high. Oil prices surged above 100 dollars per barrel amid Middle East tensions, putting downward pressure on equities. The Korean won strengthened, with the won-dollar rate dropping to the 1,350 range, and analysts suggest potential for 1,200 won levels if the Korean won continues appreciating. Tanker shipping ETFs recorded remarkable gains of over 4,000% year-to-date as container shipping rates soared due to geopolitical disruptions.
sections.Industry & Technology: A KAIST research team published findings on how a quadruped robot completed a full marathon using 32% less energy than humans, analyzing actual running data and motor efficiency.
